identification: Vintage Japanese 'KGNDG' fine china dinner service, white porcelain with a black and gold band rim and silver/gold line (roughly 6 place settings: dinner plates, side plates, bowls, cups and saucers, about 30 pieces). KGNDG is a Japanese export mark (c.1960s-70s, mostly Imari patterns). Photo shows no readable backstamp.
